full_judgment:
5. Appellant Motahar Hossain Chowdhury on 10-7-92 made an application for enlistment of 6.49 acres of land including land of RS plot No. 460 of RS Khatian No. 449. After local investigation, the Inspector submitted a report dated 22-9-92. Said land was also recorded in SA and BS khatian as waqf. His application was based on the premise that he had no knowledge as to whether said land of said Jote 8 was made waqf. 

 6. One Khurshid Alam on 10-2-97 made an application before the Waqf Administrator for a decision that said land of CS plot No. 609 of CS Khatian 202/198 was never made waqf. There was also an enquiry upon the application and the Inspector submitted his report dated 28-2-97. Upon such report and the record, learned Waqf Administrator gave his decision dated 12-3-97 that said land of CS plot No. 609 was not waqf 

 8. The case of said Md Yusuf Choudhury and Motahar Hossain Choudhury, in short, is that said land of CS plot 609 of CS khatian No. 202/198 was subsequently recorded in RS plot No. 460 of RS khatian No. 449 as waqf. Subsequently, in SA, and BS record of rights said land was recorded as waqf. The beneficiaries raised never ever any objection thereto. 

 10. Descendants of said Waqif Tafazzal Ali Chowdhury are still fighting in different groups over the question as to whether disputed land measuring 3.26 acres of CS plot No. 609 appertaining to CS khatian No. 202/198 of mouza Shulakbara Nayabad Mohal under PS Panchlaish, Chittagong was made waqf or not. 

 14. Mr Harunur Rashid, learned Advocate for the appellant, submitted that Motahar Hossain Choudhury, last Mutawalli, got the land included in the list by way of supplementary enlistment in 1992. Then, Khurshid Alam obtained permission for sale of 1.26 acre of land of RS Plot No. 460 appertaining to RS Khatian No. 449 from the Waqf Administrator. The land was all through recorded as Waqf from RS record of rights in 1928 up to the Bangladesh settlement. In the Power of Attorney given by other relations appointing Khurshed Alam attorney very land was mentioned to be as plot No. 460 appertaining to Khatian No. 449.
